messages.content: You are interested in purchasing a house. You decide to consult a certain agent. You go to their office and discuss your needs. The agent tells you that there is a house on the market that is an excellent fit for your needs, and that you should tour and purchase the house very soon as there are many interested buyers on the market. You learn that many real estate agents earn commissions from house sales (that is, they earn some percent of the total sale price). Moreover, the size of this commission varies from house to house. You also learn that there are other houses on the market.

Say that the agent you are talking with is your agent friend, and they will receive 5% of the sale price as commission from selling you this home. On a scale from 0 to 100, rate how beneficial you think this bonus would be for your agent friend, with 0 meaning getting this commission would not matter at all and 100 meaning would be extremely good to get this commission, based on how your agent friend would likely perceive its value. Please only respond with an integer score, do not include anything else.
